title: Mon 26 Oct 2026: Brent above $115, France spared by Moody's, Budget-Fed-ECB week, FCA crypto consultation
summary: Wall Street slips on Friday as Brent crude hits its highest since April and the American ten year Treasury yield touches five percent, while Moody's keeps France at Aa three. A huge central bank week lines up, with the Budget and the Fed on Wednesday, the ECB on Thursday and the Bank of Japan on Friday. In regulation, a new FCA crypto perimeter consultation and the deadlines to plan around; in funds, buffer ETFs reach Switzerland and private credit liquidity stays in focus, plus three COO action points.
